text:
acme_ops: Hey team — our prod service (acme-payment) started getting intermittent 403s with body `{"error":"signature_mismatch"}` when calling POST /v1/responses. Started ~2025-09-12 03:03 UTC. Rate ~1 failure / 5 requests. sample resp header: `x-rw-request-id: rwd-9f8a7c2`

jess: Thanks — can you paste a minimal curl repro (please redact keys) and the full response headers (including x-rw-request-id)? Also which token/org did you use?

acme_ops: repro below (redacted token). we used org id `org-acme-01` and project `payments-prod`
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/responses \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-RW-ORG-ID: org-acme-01" \\n  -d '{"input":"charge customer"}'
```
response headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
x-rw-request-id: rwd-9f8a7c2
content-length: 72
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 03:04:05 GMT
```

mike: can you also capture a debug bundle? run `rwctl collect --request rwd-9f8a7c2` (this will redact keys). we need the signing trace + canonicalized headers from the server side.

acme_ops: ran it, uploading bundle now (link private). also saw an entry in our logs: `SignatureVerificationFailed: expected sig=abc123 got=def456` around same timestamp.

sre-bot: alert: elevated 403s for org-acme-01; 27 failures in last 5m, avg latency 210ms.

eng-tom: looking at the bundle — quick hypothesis: token claims `org_id: org-acme-01` but incoming request had header `X-RW-ORG-ID: org-acme-02` in one sample. that would cause signature mismatch if the client signs headers. can you grep your fleet for `X-RW-ORG-ID` usage?

acme_ops: omg — we did a config roll 03:00 UTC to route some jobs to staging, a templating bug might have used `org-acme-02` in the header for a subset. searching now.

jess: that fits the pattern of intermittent failures. two asks: 1) confirm which requests included mismatched org header (grep + sample request-ids), 2) if you can reproduce locally with wrong org header, paste the full failing curl (again redact token).

acme_ops: found ~120 requests with wrong header between 03:01-03:06. sample failing curl (we replaced token with REDACTED):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/responses \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-RW-ORG-ID: org-acme-02" \\n  -d '{"input":"charge customer"}'
```
response: same 403 + `x-rw-request-id: rwd-9f8a7c2`

mike: confirmed: when header org != token org and client signs headers as part of HMAC canonicalization, server signature check fails -> 403. We'll add clearer docs but this is expected behavior.

eng-tom: also noticed one additional bug in our SDK v2.2.0: it would include `x-rw-trace` in canonicalized headers only if present, but drop-case normalization was inconsistent which could cause false mismatches for some clients. patch ready for v2.2.1 that normalizes header names before signing.

acme_ops: thanks — we rolled back the templating change and are reissuing requests. after rollback rate of 403s dropped to baseline.

jess: root cause summary for the ticket: customer-side header templating error caused X-RW-ORG-ID to be set to wrong org for subset of requests -> signature verification fails (403). Mitigations: 1) customer rolled back config (done), 2) docs: clarify header must match token org, 3) internal: SDK patch to normalize header casing in v2.2.1 (eng-tom PR #412).

acme_ops: appreciate the fast help! please keep me posted when v2.2.1 is out so we can upgrade. :pray:

jess: will do, marking this one resolved on our side. closing after 24h without recurrence. :white_check_mark:
